description: The tables in one dataset, without the full column schemas — the cheap call when you only need table ids and titles. Example: {"dataset_slug": "kden-metar-hourly"}. Returns {dataset_slug, main_table, tables: [{id, slug, title, display_title?, description?, section?, license, version_id, capabilities}]} in curated order. section contains id, title and collapsed; collapsed is only a UI preference, not an access restriction. Use get_dataset instead when you also want columns.
name: list_tables
title: List a dataset's tables
